excerpts.content: After deposit you have to wait for the deposit to be inserted in the eth2 chain, and then wait for activation. This may take a few hours

excerpts.author: protolambda
excerpts.content: And a validator attests every epoch, i.e. every 32 slots it is assigned participate in a random committee
